mission.title: The Device
mission.description: Obtain a prototype device from the Exile Coyote.

npc.say: All right... are you sure no one is listening? I am being stalked by shadowy figures. Just when I think I'm alone, I see them out of the corner of my eye... and then they're gone! I'm certain they are after my device. If you can free me from my stalkers, you may have the device prototype. Please, you must help me! Do you understand?

phase.briefing: Ah, {player}, how opportune that you have contacted me. I have a task for you to fulfill. We require that you obtain a certain... device for us. I am updating your HUD with the location and identity of an Exile who has a prototype of the device. Obtain it from him.

enter.say: The Exile, Coyote, is in this building right now -- looks like we've caught him while he's away from his lab.

talk.say: Who are you? Why are you here? The device? Wait... are you with... them? There is a private room near here with a computer. Take me there and we can speak more freely...

objective.text: Find the private room with the computer

talk.say: All right... are you sure no one is listening? I am being stalked by shadowy figures. Just when I think I'm alone, I see them out of the corner of my eye... and then they're gone! I'm certain they are after my device. If you can free me from my stalkers, you may have the device prototype. Please, you must help me! Do you understand?

done.say: Shadowy figures? I think this guy is cracked... let's get outside and see what Gray has to say about this.

phase.briefing: Do not dismiss the ramblings of this Exile, {player}. In fact, we had already anticipated some... resistance to our actions, from the Merovingian. An activity scan of the previous twelve hours indicates unusual Exile traffic from a nearby location. We have matched the activity to known Merovingian associates; analysis indicates a high likelihood that these individuals are responsible for the harassment of Coyote. Proceed to the specified location and eliminate any Exiles you find.

enter.say: This is the spot that Gray pointed out... I'm picking up some activity in there. Keep your eyes open!

done.say: Nice, you've taken out all the Exiles.

phase.briefing: You have eliminated the threat to Coyote. Proceed to his laboratory and obtain the device from him.

enter.say: I hope he's happy that you took care-- Huh? The code's looking a little strange in there. Keep your eyes open for anything unusual.
Damn! There's Coyote... I'm running a quick scan... There's no sign of the device anywhere in the area! Check the bodies and see if you can find anything of interest.

done.say: A schematic, huh? I think you should get out of there and upload it at a hardline. Agent Gray can figure out where to go from there.

objective.text: Upload the schematic at a hardline

mission.finish: It would appear that your intervention was too late; the Merovingian has compromised our plans. I am receiving the data from your operator. I will forward it to my colleagues, and we will proceed from there. Contact me for further instructions.
